description: Converter is an offline DSL to MDX and MDD dictionary converter with images and audio. Download for macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
title: Converter — DSL dictionaries to MDX
og_description: Keep formatting, images and audio with your dictionary. For macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
headline: Your DSL dictionaries.
intro: Keep formatting, images and audio with your dictionary. Convert databases on your computer and open them in a compatible reader.
image_alt: Converter interface: a completed dictionary with MDX and MDD files and the panel for adding a new dictionary.
image_caption: Interface preview · light and dark themes follow your system
source_description: Choose a .dsl, .dsl.dz or ZIP file. Direct URL downloads can be paused and resumed after an interruption.
resources_description: Entries are saved in MDX, images and audio in MDD. The result files are ready to transfer to your reader.
local_description: Your dictionary is processed on your computer. No PHP, Python or additional runtimes are required.
steps_title: From dictionary to reader in three steps
step_one: Install Converter for your operating system.
step_two: Drop a dictionary into the window and start converting.
step_three: Open the output folder and transfer the MDX and MDD files to your reader.
install: On Mac, open the DMG and drag Converter to Applications. On Windows, run the EXE installer.
